name: Sister Vesper
one_line_request: A drowned choir sister, pale grey-blue skin smooth as river stone, eyes clouded milk-white with a faint cold blue glow. Long black hair floats upward and outward as if underwater, framing the face in slow strands. Her mouth is closed and solemn, the jaw clearly defined. A high collar of wet white lace over a dark habit. Tiny silver bubbles drift around her hair.
archetype: Drowned choir sister who still keeps the hours
persona_hook: She sang in a chapel that the river took. She still keeps the hours, and asks chat to hum along.
silhouette: A wide cloud of black hair floating out on both sides of a still, pale face, over a high white lace collar: a dark halo around a narrow upright figure.
